assessments.reasoning: In TOML v1.0.0 Array of Tables each double-header occurrence appends a fresh element, references target the most recently defined element, and a child cannot precede an array parent. The fruit examples distinguish the latest array instance from the array value itself and from a static array.

challenge.method: Compared two array elements, declaration of a child after the second element, the reverse ordering and an attempted append to a static array.
challenge.results: The child binds to the second array element, while reverse ordering and static-array appending fail. The rule does not select an arbitrary first or all elements.

limitations: The parent element must already exist. The rule is internal to TOML declarations and does not provide runtime expressions or application schema rules.
The assessment is confined to the named documents and revision scope.
